dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical convergence of the lateral margins from the mid-dorsal region towards the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Widespread, high-density mottling with lighter linear streaks and darker diffuse patches distributed across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, with soft gradients between the dark grey base and lighter streaked regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple parallel linear light-grey streaks on the left and right lateral surfaces; a faint circular depigmented patch on the mid-left side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of numerous shallow linear rake marks longitudinally oriented along the dorsal surface.
